text:
maria_pm: quick sync — Nebula (customer) asked for an initial launch in ~6w: embeddings + server-side rerank + chat/completions parity. They flagged latency and determinism requirements. can we cut scope and still meet their ask?
kevin_eng: 6w is tight. need to clarify SLOs. are they expecting <200ms p95 for rerank? or is 300–400ms tolerable?
ravi_ml: from an ML standpoint, server-side rerank with dense embeddings + ANN is doable if we limit k to 20 and use pre-warmed indexes. latency depends on index warmup and shard count. quantization helps.
jessica_solutions: Nebula says p95 <= 300ms for search rerank, and embeddings batch within 150ms for single doc. They value deterministic tie-breaking and stable scores across model rollouts.
kevin_eng: propose cutlist for v1: (A) no multi-turn chat sessions — single-turn completions only; (B) no fusion endpoint that merges chat+rerank; (C) fixed rerank pipeline server-side with top_k=20 and optional client-limit param; (D) we ship hosted + dedicated plan later, initial launch on their Dedicated instance to hit SLOs.
maria_pm: sounds reasonable. let's capture acceptance criteria so we can tell sales/customer what they'll get.
ravi_ml: acceptance criteria draft: 1) Rerank p95 end-to-end <= 300ms for queries with top_k=20 on their Dedicated config; 2) Embedding API 99th percentile per-request <= 150ms for 1 doc, 10 concurrent; 3) Deterministic tie-breaker implemented (stable sort by doc_id for equal scores); 4) Model rollout fallback: if new model has >2% regressions on owner-provided eval set, automatic rollback; 5) Partial failure semantics: if rerank fails, return embeddings + client-side fallback header.
tom_cs: customer also wants clear failure mode: on partial failures they want HTTP 200 with field "partial": true and "reason" text so their frontend can show a degraded state.
jessica_solutions: +1 on the API shape for partials. also need an SLA note: no credit for cold cache misses in first 72h of index build. call out caching behavior.
kevin_eng: edge cases to call out in PRD: cold ANN index builds, variable-length documents >32k tokens for embeddings, requests with top_k=0, empty query strings, malicious inputs (huge payloads). we should cap sizes and return 413 for >X bytes.
maria_pm: let's add explicit acceptance tests: a) runner that issues 10k synthetic queries against their dataset and measures p50/p95/p99; b) owner-provided eval set (1000 queries) must have no quality regression >2% after rollout.
ravi_ml: implementation notes: use quantized 8-bit embeddings for storage, product-ANN with per-shard warming; for rerank we can run small cross-encoder on top-10 from ANN to improve quality (two-stage). that adds ~50ms but keeps within 300ms if tuned.
kevin_eng: ops note: autoscale policy for Dedicated — min replicas to satisfy p95 under target qps, and warmup lifecycle when index changes. Also add canary route for new model versions (10% traffic) with metrics: latency, score-drift vs baseline.
maria_pm: API contract snippet for client docs (v1):
```
POST /v1/search/rerank
{
  "query": "...",
  "candidates": ["doc_id1", "doc_id2", ...],
  "top_k": 20,
  "client_fallback": false
}
response:
{
  "results": [{"doc_id":"doc_id1","score":0.87}, ...],
  "partial": false,
  "meta": {"rerank_latency_ms": 123}
}
```
kevin_eng: we need to include request size limits and timeout header (e.g., X-Client-Deadline-ms) to allow preemptive cancellation. also log sampling guidance for PII-safe logs.
jessica_solutions: customer asks for a rollout checklist: 1) dataset ingest & index build verification; 2) perf run (10k queries); 3) run customer eval; 4) enable canary 10% 24h; 5) promote.
tom_cs: client wants visibility in Console: per-route p95, per-model score drift, and last index rebuild timestamp. can we expose that?
kevin_eng: yes — Console work needed but minimal: per-route dashboards + index metadata. add to scope as "Console telemetry for Nebula (landing page)".
maria_pm: final proposed cutlist to share with customer: ship embeddings + server-side rerank + single-turn completions; no fusion/multi-turn chat; no client-side rerank helpers in v1; dedicated infra only for initial launch; Console telemetry limited to per-route metrics.
jessica_solutions: send that to Nebula tonight. I'll flag the acceptance criteria and rollout checklist.
ravi_ml: open engineering risks: quality drift from ANN+cross-encoder tuning, latency regression on cold shard rebuilds. mitigation: baseline eval + extra warm-up capacity.
kevin_eng: owners/action items:
- kevin_eng: infra architecture + autoscale + timeout headers (ETA 2w)
- ravi_ml: rerank two-stage impl + eval harness (ETA 3w)
- maria_pm: finalize PRD & customer comms (ETA 2d)
- jessica_solutions: run customer expectations, confirm SLA language (ETA 2d)
- tom_cs: coordinate index ingest window and dataset access (ETA 1w)
- deploy-bot: schedule canary once flagged by kevin_eng
maria_pm: decision: v1 cutlist approved. share PRD draft with Nebula and schedule a 30m alignment call tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: heads-up — canary pipeline available; runbook link: https://internal.runbook.local/canary-v2
kevin_eng: one more small thing — add deterministic score hashing so tie-break reproducible across replicas. low-effort.
maria_pm: noted. thanks everyone — will post PRD link when done.
